mapper.select: SELECT id, outbound_id, sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, quantity, picked_qty, location_id, scanned, created_at, updated_at FROM outbound_order_item WHERE outbound_id = #{outboundId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT id, outbound_id, sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, quantity, picked_qty, location_id, scanned, created_at, updated_at FROM outbound_order_item WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, outbound_id, sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, quantity, picked_qty, location_id, scanned, created_at, updated_at FROM outbound_order_item WHERE outbound_id = #{outboundId} AND sku_code = #{skuCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO outbound_order_item (outbound_id, sku_id, sku_code, sku_name, quantity, location_id) VALUES (#{outboundId}, #{skuId}, #{skuCode}, #{skuName}, #{quantity}, #{locationId})
